forbidden_elements: Pink backgrounds or excessive pink gradients
Giant glowing pink hearts or roses
Anime, chibi, or generic AI cartoon styles in the comic section

headings.usage: Major headings, chapter titles, cinematic reveals

body.usage: UI elements, navigation hints, small reading text

handwritten.usage: Personal notes, doodles, letters, comic typography

textures: Film grain overlay across chapters 1-4, 6 (using CSS noise or SVG filter)
lighting: Warm radial gradients acting as 'lamps' or 'streetlights' (e.g., radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,175,55,0.1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%))
Vignette effects around the edges to focus attention on the center

grids_and_layouts.global_navigation: No standard navbar. Use chapter-based progression (cinematic transitions between components). State persisted client-side.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_1_landing: Full viewport height, centered alignment for title, absolute positioning for parallax stars and foreground silhouettes.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_2_memories: Asymmetric Bento or scatter layout for polaroids. Overlapping z-indexes, varying subtle rotations.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_3_little_world: Fixed aspect ratio 'stage' (ambient living room scene) with absolutely positioned interactive elements.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_4_apology: Minimalist centered layout, dark room focus on the desk lamp and physical envelope elements.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_5_comic: Scrapbook aesthetic. Cream paper background. Multi-slide or vertical scroll with taped notes and hand-drawn elements.
grids_and_layouts.chapter_6_final: Maximum negative space. Centered text reveals, ending in a single responsive image container.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Cinematic, slow, intentional. High-quality ease-in-out curves. Framer Motion is mandatory.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Slow crossfades, subtle blurs, and scale-ins.
motion_and_interactions.chapter_1: Stars appear gradually, ambient movement. Mouse parallax on stars/foreground. Hovering near silhouette brightens it. Clickable hidden stars.
motion_and_interactions.chapter_2: Polaroids lift on hover. Click reveals handwritten notes/stickers. Progress tracks 'Memories discovered: 0/5'.
motion_and_interactions.chapter_3: Objects animate independently on loops (e.g., breathing lamp, moving curtains, beating heart).
motion_and_interactions.chapter_6: Typewriter effect or slow opacity reveals for text. Sequential storytelling.

setup: This is a FRONTEND-ONLY interactive romantic story website. Do not build a backend.
Import the Google Fonts in index.css.
Setup Framer Motion for all complex animations.
Use lucide-react for minimal icons (like music play/pause).
execution_phases: 1. Build the global layout wrapper and state management for chapter progression.
2. Implement Chapter 1 with audio control, parallax, hidden stars, and cinematic enter transition.
3. Implement Chapter 2 with 5 interactive polaroids and the unlock logic.
4. Implement Chapter 3 with the ambient room and independently animating CSS/Framer elements.
5. Implement Chapter 4 with the 5 envelope letters.
6. Implement Chapter 5 with the scrapbook comic style (switch background to cream, text to dark ink).
7. Implement Chapter 6 with cinematic text reveals.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where it enhances the cinematic feel. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com etc). Use provided media URLs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use generic AI assistant emojis.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use subtle text-shadows over images.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for continuous looping animations.
